resources.string: Typed selections: %1$s saved now, %2$s in the retained revision.\nRelationships: %3$s saved now, %4$s in the retained revision.\nThe complete saved component and relationship configurations will be replaced, including catalog versions, roles, enabled states, settings and recorded extra fields. Matching counts do not mean matching content.

%1$s\n\nRestore all domain content from this retained revision, including objective, context, workload inputs, primary model, typed components and their relationships, and optional-tier configuration? This immediately saves a new RESTORE revision and retains earlier history. Current saved title, sample pins and other metadata stay unchanged. Unsaved objective/context/workload edits will be replaced on successful acknowledgement; unsaved title/sample edits remain in the editor and still need Save locally. Failure keeps visible edits. No report, price or compatibility result is restored or re-evaluated.
